paragraphs.text: Turn your DSH sessions into an animated character stage with Codex Pet support.
# Agent Theater
**English** | 简体中文
Turns a DSH session into a **character stage**: a `conversation.view` called **Theater** sits beside
Chat and Trajectory. The character reacts to real tool events, your message becomes a short comic b
ubble, the agent's output becomes a subtitle, and when a turn ends she presents the result and its d
eliverables on stage.
- No fork, no changes to DSH core; only public extension points (`conversation.view` slot, standard

Client hooks, the `ctx.sidebarRight` / `ctx.uiConversation` services).
- **No extra model calls**: e

very line comes from the Chat data the Conversation layer already assembled.
- Chat and Trajectory s
tay intact and are one click away; uninstalling the plugin restores the default UI.
## Features
- **One stage, not a chat list**: the whole view is the stage — scene label, a large character (prop

s, halo, badge), and a bottom deck for comic bubbles, subtitles and a shared status bar.
- **Four sc
enes** driven by real session state: Idle · Working (live tool + operation count + timer) · Completi

on (report card) · Attention (request card).
- **Completion report**: the turn's real final answer (
Markdown, collapsed by default, expandable, copyable) + real statistics (read/search/run/edit, elaps
ed time) + **delivered files, edited files and attachments**; `present` descriptions render under th

e file name, a file row opens in the right Sidebar and a thumbnail opens an in-stage lightbox.
- **A
ttention**: shows the real approval reason or the real question and options (read-only). Acting stil

l happens in the native approval UI / composer — the plugin never approves for you.
- **Codex Pet**:
import a `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp` folder and the character becomes a frame-by-frame sprite a

nimation; without a Pet it uses a built-in placeholder character.
- **Restrained**: tool calls never
enter the narrative; they only show up in the status bar and props. There is no history list — the
full log stays in Chat.
| Working (with an imported Pet) | Completion |
| Attention | No Pet (built-in placeholder) |
> The character in these screenshots is a **locally imported Codex Pet**; no character art ships wit
h this repository. Without a Pet the built-in placeholder is used.
## Install
Requires DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.x** (tested on `0.2.1-rc.5`; the package declares `engines.dsh`). Af
ter installing, **refresh the page once** (Client modules are read at page load) and the view switch
er above the conversation will offer **Theater**.
### Option A: install from GitHub (recommended)
In DSH's **Plugins** page choose install and paste:

DSH 0.2.1+ can read plugin-market indexes (JSON, format 1) under **Plugins → Discover → Index source
s**. This repository ships one; add this URL to search and install it from Discover:

Fallback (not a CDN; on some networks it can exceed the 15-second budget DSH gives an index source):

### After installing

1. Refresh the page, then use the view switcher above the conversation → **Theater**.
2. Import a Co

dex Pet if you want one (see below); it is optional.
3. To turn it off, disable the bundle on the Pl
ugins page (you are back to plain Chat immediately); see uninstall at the end.
## The character: Codex Pet
### Import
Click **Select Pet assets** in the Theater toolbar → the native folder picker → choose a folder cont
aining `pet.json`. The assets are **copied** into a dedicated directory; the source folder stays rea
d-only and untouched:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`pet.json` fields: `id`, `displayName`, `description`, `spriteVersionNumber` (only `2` is accepted)
and `spritesheetPath` (a relative path inside the Pet folder; `..` and absolute paths are rejected).
Sheets may be up to 24MB, webp/png/jpeg/avif, and their pixel size must be a multiple of the frame
ts may be up to 24MB, webp/png/jpeg/avif, and their pixel size must be a multiple of the frame grid.
## Compatibility
- Built and tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` (macOS; CI runs Ubuntu + macOS). Public interfaces used:
- View registration: `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.view', () => ctx.slots.register({ name, id, or

der, label, locale }, Component))`
- Data: slot props `useChat` (`{order, nodes}`), `useSessionStatu

s` (`running` / `pendingInteraction`), `openView('chat', focus)`
- Deliverables: `ctx.sidebarRight.o

penResource`, `ctx.uiConversation.imageUrl` / `peekImageUrl`
- Pet store: Host routes authenticated

through `ctx.connection.admit`, plus `uiWorkspace.pickDirectory`
- Text: `ctx.locale.register/bind`;

styling uses theme tokens only (`--dsw-alias-*`)
- DSH is still in rc: slot and service signatures
may change. If the view is blank after a DSH upgrade, report the browser console line `slot entry cr
ashed in 'conversation.view'` in an issue.
## Known limitations
- Without a Pet the character is an SVG + CSS placeholder; with one it is a frame-by-frame sprite an

imation (not Live2D).
- Only the latest text beat is visible on stage; earlier conversation lives in

Chat / Trajectory (by design).
- Attachments list image references only; non-image attachments (PDF

, code files, …) are not listed in the report yet.
- Markdown is a practical subset: no tables, imag

es, task lists or inline HTML, and no syntax highlighting.
- Props map from tool names (`theaterPose

ForTool`); unknown tools fall back to the generic working pose.
- Very narrow windows (<520px) squee

ze the character and the cards; there is no "character only" fallback yet.
- The sprite sheet is dow

nloaded whole on first paint and reused through ETag 304; rows are not fetched separately.
- The Hos
t side only stores and validates assets; it never decodes images — the browser measures the grid.
